title: SDET -2
location: The Address Featherlite Bengaluru, Bengaluru, Karnataka , India
jobDescription:
Experience 3 - 6years

Experience in manual and automation testing across Web, Mobile Apps, and APIs. The ideal candidate should be comfortable validating data using SQL, monitoring application logs, executing comprehensive test plans, and contributing to test automation frameworks to ensure high-quality product releases.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform manual testing for web applications, mobile apps, and backend services to validate functionality, usability, and integration across systems.

• Design and execute test cases, test scenarios, test plans, and test reports for end-to-end validation.

•Conduct API testing using tools like Postman/Rest Assured to verify request response handling, business logic, and error scenarios.

• Perform database validation and data integrity testing using SQL queries.

• Review and monitor application/server logs to identify defects, trace failures, and support debugging efforts.

• Execute cross-browser and cross-device testing to ensure consistent user experience.

• Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to clarify requirements and validate fixes.

• Actively contribute to test automation efforts including scripting, execution, and maintenance of automated test suites.

• Participate in regression testing, sanity testing, and release certification.

• Identify, document, and track defects using common defect-tracking tools (JIRA or similar).

• Support continuous improvement of QA processes, tools, and best practices.

Required Skills Core Testing Skills

• Strong hands-on experience in Manual Testing (Functional, Regression, Smoke/Sanity, Integration testing).

• Experience testing Web Applications, Mobile Apps (Android/iOS), and APIs.

• Practical knowledge of API testing tools (Postman, Swagger, Rest Assured, etc.).

• Ability to write and execute SQL queries for backend data validation.

• Experience with application log analysis and troubleshooting (Kibana, CloudWatch, Splunk, or similar tools).

• Solid understanding of SDLC/STLC and Agile methodologies.

Automation Skills

• Hands-on experience in test automation using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, or similar.

• Knowledge of at least one programming language: Java, Python, or JavaScript.

• Ability to create and maintain automation scripts and test frameworks.

• Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines is a plus.

Tools & Technologies:

• Testing Tools: Postman, Rest Assured, Selenium/Appium/Playwright/Cypress

• Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server

• Bug Tracking: JIRA, Azure DevOps or similar

• CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Actions or equivalent

• Version Control: Git

• Log Monitoring: Kibana, Splunk, CloudWatch, or similar

Soft Skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Good communication and collaboration abilities.

• Attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Nice-to-Have

• Experience with API, Web automation

• Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).

title: Associate Manager- Legal
location: The Address Featherlite Bengaluru, Bengaluru, Karnataka , India
jobDescription:
Position :- Associate Manager - Legal

Experience :- 3 to 5 Years

Location - Bangalore

Responsibilities:

·             Advising the business teams on applicable legal and regulatory framework for moneyview’s existing and new products

·            Advising the business teams of moneyview on regulatory environments relevant to the BFSI sector including on data protection, privacy and information security

·       Drafting and negotiating a wide range of commercial contracts with business partners (sourcing and collection contracts with financial institutions, tech vendor contracts, marketing contracts, payment support services contracts)

·         Drafting and updating the standard form contracts entered into with customers and policies of moneyview (terms and conditions, privacy policy and general terms of use) 

·             Advising on other general corporate commercial matters for the moneyview group

·          Management of internal stakeholders and negotiating with external stakeholders; liaising effectively with an array of consultants, advisors and external counsel to manage multiple projects

Qualifications:

  • Law degree from a recognised, well-ranked university
  • Between 3-5 years of relevant PQE
  • Experience in legal drafting, research, and negotiation of commercial contracts
  • Strong analytical and interpersonal skills with an ability to work and take considered decisions
  • Experience working with at a corporate law firm and / or as in-house counsel in a fintech is preferred
  • The candidate should be able to work independently and exercise sound and practical judgment
